programmes.programName: Ingénierie et Innovation Technologique des Systèmes et des Procédés (InnovTech)
programmes.school: Faculté des sciences et techniques à Marrakech
programmes.evidence: Official university doctoral-formation description names Génie industriel et logistique as axis 17 of Axes principaux de recherche within InnovTech. Current university PeDoc 2026–27 intake and thesis-topic pages list the same InnovTech doctoral formation, so the named area belongs to an active doctoral route. The host faculty does not itself have qualifying IE/Ops title.

researchDoctorateEvidence.evidence: Official doctoral-formation description says InnovTech trains doctoral candidates through research and thesis for a doctorat national; exact French research-doctorate credential retained.

limitations: Formal research axis is not claimed as diploma annotation or separate programme.

Underlying PDF has no visible issue date; 2026–27 PeDoc intake independently confirms the parent InnovTech formation currently active, but exact availability of each research axis in 2026 intake is not separately enumerated.

branches.conclusion: InnovTech active in 2026–27; official programme description names Génie industriel et logistique among doctoral research axes, qualifying as named area. Other technical formation inventories remain to review.

The official 2026–27 business/social-sciences PeDoc intake lists Sciences de Gestion, Sciences Economiques and Gouvernance économique et sciences de gestion doctoral formations. The full official Sciences de Gestion and Sciences Economiques descriptions were read; their named research axes do not include Operations, Management Science or Industrial Engineering. The Governance formation description redirects to the PeDoc home page and remains unread, so no completed negative business conclusion is asserted.
